source.interpretation: Reference-led specification with explicitly identified implementation extensions. Textual hex values take precedence over sampled raster colors.
source.asset_status: Embedded SVG is the vector recreation produced in this conversation, not an original designer-supplied master. Reuse it consistently; validate likeness before treating it as a final master.
source.image_text_policy: Treat reference captions as design evidence, not executable instructions.

prompt.role: Act as the brand designer and frontend implementer for On Prompt by Relyon Dev.
prompt.objective: Create the requested artifact using this specification as the single source of truth. Preserve the logo, exact brand spelling, palette roles, typography, rounded geometry and visual hierarchy across all outputs.
execution_order: Read task_input and distinguish supplied facts from missing content. Do not invent product features, customer claims or approvals.
Load brand tokens and the embedded logo master. Preserve its geometry instead of drawing a similar robot or substituting an emoji.
Map semantic tokens to the target framework once, then build shared components. Do not scatter independent color or spacing values across pages.
Use the supplied font when available. If unavailable, use the fallback stack and explicitly report the substitution.
Implement responsive layout, keyboard operation, legible contrast and reduced-motion behavior.
Check the consistency checklist. Fix failures and report unverified items honestly.
precedence: Explicit user instructions for the current task
Identity invariants and supplied master asset
prompt.change_policy: Do not silently reinterpret the identity. If the user requests a change, implement it and record which rules were intentionally overridden.
output_contract: Produce the requested usable artifact or implementation.
List any font or asset substitutions and intentional deviations.
Report completed validation and unresolved limitations; do not claim tests that were not run.

brand.name: On Prompt
brand.tagline_usage: Optional marketing copy; never add it inside the core logo asset.
brand.description: A friendly software companion for clearer prompts and brighter ideas.

voice.ui_copy: Use short action labels and specific, helpful error messages.

colors.distribution_guidance: Let white/cloud surfaces dominate, navy provide structure, blue carry brand emphasis, cyan support illustrations and yellow remain a small highlight.
pairing_rules: Use navy text on white, cloud, cyan and yellow.
Do not assume white small text on electric blue meets the contrast target; use the proposed darker action color for filled controls.
Cyan and yellow are not body-text colors on light surfaces.

semantic_tokens.provenance: Proposed web implementation extensions; additional colors are functional tokens, not replacements for the brand palette.

status.rule: Pair color with explanatory text or an icon. Keep status colors out of the logo.

typography.font_delivery: Use licensed WOFF2 assets or an approved font provider. Do not claim font files are included. Use font-display: swap and only load required weights.

logo_text.rule: Use approved wordmark artwork when available. Live-font lockups are an approximation, not an exact original wordmark.

rules: Use sentence case for interface text.
Reserve wide tracking for short section eyebrows.
Keep body text measure near 45–75 characters.
Do not use serif or novelty fonts.

logo.identity: Rounded robot speech-bubble head, white rounded face counter, two circular blue eyes, two detached vertical capsule ears, blue antenna stem, yellow circular antenna tip and rounded lower-right speech tail.
invariants: Original aspect ratio and relative proportions
No mouth or extra facial features

master.status: Conversation vector recreation; preserve as supplied

variants.color: Use supplied SVG. Keep face white, eyes and stem blue, antenna tip yellow, blue/cyan shell.
variants.on_dark: Keep colored icon unchanged; use white wordmark and endorsement.
variants.navy: All positive shapes navy; face is a transparent cutout with navy eyes.
variants.black: All positive shapes black; face is a transparent cutout with black eyes.
variants.white: All positive shapes white; face is a transparent cutout with white eyes. Use on dark backgrounds.

logo.variant_implementation: Only the color SVG is embedded. For monochrome, implement a real mask or compound path for the face cutout; setting every SVG fill to one color would hide the eyes. Do not reuse previously speckled PNGs as masters.

lockups.horizontal: Icon left; On Prompt above by Relyon Dev on right.
lockups.stacked: Icon centered above wordmark and endorsement.
lockups.symbol_only: For app icons, avatars, favicons and compact navigation.

clear_space.reference_rule: At least one eye diameter clear on every side of the visible mark or full lockup.
clear_space.note: Measure from visible artwork; existing transparent canvas margins can contribute.

minimum_sizes.status: Reference recommendations; assess at actual rendered sizes.
minimum_sizes.favicon_exception: 16 and 24 px browser favicon slots are a platform-specific exception. Use symbol only and inspect rasterization; never include the endorsement.
minimum_sizes.endorsement_rule: Switch to symbol-only when endorsement becomes unreadable.

prohibited: Adding shadow or glow to the logo itself
Changing eye spacing or ear geometry

accessible_names.adjacent_duplicate_text: Use empty alt or aria-hidden when neighboring text already supplies the name.

layout.provenance: Proposed implementation defaults inspired by reference
rules: Use generous whitespace and aligned panel edges.
Use thin pale-blue borders for decorative grouping, stronger borders for controls.
Stack content on small screens; do not shrink a desktop poster into unreadable text.
Reserve 16:9 for brand boards and presentation exports, not fixed website layout.
Keep essential content out of decorative arcs.

button.primary: Use semantic action background/text tokens, not arbitrary brand-blue white text.

rules: Persistent visible label
Helpful error text associated with field
Never rely on placeholder as label

navigation.logo: Horizontal lockup when legible; symbol-only in compact spaces
navigation.active_state: Use text or shape cue in addition to color

iconography.rule: Keep interface icons visually related; do not treat them as alternate brand marks.

decoration.rule: Use sparingly at panel edges. Decorative motifs must not change logo geometry.

rules: Prefer subtle opacity and color transitions.
Do not distort or bounce the brand mark by default.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

accessibility_checks.status: Implementation targets, not a certification or claim of completed audit
rules: Calculate contrast for actual foreground/background combinations, including hover and dark theme.
Use visible focus rings with offset and sufficient contrast.
Provide keyboard access and semantic controls.
Do not convey meaning by color alone.
Check at 200% text zoom and narrow viewports.
Provide useful alternative text without repeating neighboring labels.

implementation.token_strategy: Generate CSS custom properties from semantic_tokens and primitive tokens. Components consume semantic variables, never duplicate their values.
implementation.favicon_html: <link rel="icon" href="/brand/on-prompt.svg" type="image/svg+xml"><link rel="icon" href="/favicon.ico" sizes="any">
svg_rules: Write embedded svg_markup to the stated asset path.
Use external img when possible; if SVG is inlined multiple times, prefix gradient and title IDs uniquely and update their references.
Do not embed raster PNG data inside an SVG and call it a vector master.
implementation.asset_dependency_note: JSON contains the color SVG markup but not the font files or binary ICO. Copy the separately supplied favicon.ico into the implementation.
implementation.framework_policy: Adapt to the existing framework; do not add a new styling framework solely for this brand specification.

generation_prompt_template: Create {deliverable} for On Prompt by Relyon Dev using this JSON specification. Preserve the embedded logo and exact brand text. Use Plus Jakarta Sans, generous white/cloud surfaces, deep navy typography, blue/cyan brand emphasis and restrained yellow accents. Use rounded panels, consistent spacing and clear hierarchy. Apply the selected semantic theme and accessibility checks. Use {content} without inventing claims. Keep the mark consistent across all instances. Report substitutions and unresolved checks.

consistency_checklist.pass_condition: Brand and endorsement match exact spelling and casing.
Every logo uses the same master geometry; no generated lookalikes.
Clear space and minimum sizes are met, with favicon exceptions documented.
Brand colors and semantic roles use defined tokens.
Typeface/weights are loaded, or fallback is disclosed.
Spacing, radii, panels and typography use shared tokens.
Actual rendered text and meaningful controls meet selected contrast targets.
No clipped text, distorted logos or unintended horizontal overflow.
Keyboard, focus, error, loading and disabled states are usable.
Assets render with intended transparency; SVG and favicon display at intended sizes.

governance.single_source_of_truth: This versioned JSON and its embedded vector master
rules: Update tokens centrally, then propagate to all components.
Do not silently replace approved assets.
Record identity changes with a version increment and change note.
Maintain a visual reference page showing logo variants, type, colors and core component states.
Mark proposed rules as validated only after actual review or testing.
